hooks.command: bash -c 'changed=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --name-only --cached 2>/dev/null) && if echo "$changed" | grep -qE "^(src/|package\.json|\.github/workflows/)" && ! echo "$changed" | grep -qE "^(README\.md|CHANGELOG\.md|CLAUDE\.md|\.claude/)"; then echo "\n[keep-docs-current] Code changed but docs (README/CHANGELOG/.claude/) were not updated this session. Consider running /docs-sync before wrapping.\n"; fi'
